citation.text: Itemized original receipts or tax invoices are strictly mandatory for any individual business expense exceeding PKR 5,000.
Any expense claim exceeding PKR 50,000 requires formal departmental manager review and written authorization.
Disbursements exceeding PKR 100,000 require secondary executive review and sign-off by the Finance Department.
Standard hotel accommodation for business travel must not exceed the maximum daily rate cap of PKR 25,000 per night.
All employee reimbursement requests must be submitted within 14 calendar days of incurring the business expense.
International travel expenses require documented vice-presidential pre-approval prior to ticket booking or travel confirmation.
